scope: On-screen keyboard for controller text entry: text_entry_requested from the host, WevaView keyboard document typing through send_text/send_key with retained HTML focus.
findings: Accept on a text field opens the keyboard with the field keeping focus and caret; keys, Shift, symbols, Space, Back type through the ordinary text path; Done and cancel close; Enter acts as the key and closes.
The sample types into the bound traveler name through the keyboard; the capture shows the keyboard under the open settings dialog with the focus ring on q.
limitations: Synthetic pad events only; no physical controller.
No layout for other scripts or a numeric-only mode; games can restyle via on_screen_keyboard_css.
